teaser: "You didn't have to do all this," someone says, looking at the table you set without being asked. You are a life path 1, the number of the leader, built on self-reliance and the nerve to go first — carried by an ISFJ, built to notice what a room needs before it asks. The pairing is specific. A 1 usually pushes forward loud and alone; here the push happens at the edges, in decisions nobody saw you make. The leading looks like holding a household together one unremarked choice at a time, and some part of you still waits to be asked before trusting yourself to do it.
excerpt: The toolbox left open on the garage workbench says more than the conversation that was supposed to happen that evening.
